analyst.summary: Kirloskar Brothers is a leading Indian pump manufacturer with a strong balance sheet and exposure to government water-infrastructure spending (rural water supply, irrigation). Full-year FY26 results were solid, but the most recent quarter showed profit down roughly 40% year-on-year alongside near-flat revenue growth - a clear near-term wobble that isn't yet explained by a specific one-off. We rate it a Hold: a fundamentally sound franchise, but recent execution needs to be watched before taking a firmer view.
